name: conditionGrid
blurb: Responsive masonry grid with staggered column widths and fade-in animations on scroll.
description: Renders a 12-column grid with images that reflow responsively. Column spans vary by item index. Motion triggers on viewport entry with a slide-up fade animation.
use_when: Portfolio or project showcase with varied aspect ratios and polished scroll animations.
avoid_when: Static galleries or when content must fit fixed column counts.
a11y: Images are not semantically marked; only decorative presentation. No keyboard navigation.
